intro.h2: A design-build team that draws your Irvine kitchen first
paragraphs: USA Home Remodeling offers kitchen remodeling in Irvine as a design-build contractor, so one team handles the consultation, 3D design, permits, construction and final walkthrough. The office is on Business Center Drive near John Wayne Airport, and the crews know the floor plans of Irvine: galley kitchens in older Woodbridge homes, semi-open layouts in University Park and open builds in Great Park.

Seeing the room in 3D first means fewer changes once walls come down. Clients from Laguna Hills to Oceanside mention the 3D mockups, a clear timeline and Isaac's steady updates. When older homes hide problems, reviewers say Isaac tells them right away instead of covering it up.

why_choose_us.h2: Why Irvine homeowners sign with USA Home Remodeling

items.title: 3D design at no charge
items.text: A 3D rendering comes with every project, with floor plans, layout options and your cabinet, counter and tile picks. Clients compare it to the finished room and say the match is close.

items.title: Three years of workmanship cover
items.text: At the final walkthrough you receive a written 3-year labor and workmanship warranty. The company says that is about three times longer than most contractors offer.

items.title: Honest about hidden problems
items.text: When an older Santa Ana home turned up issues behind the walls, a Google reviewer said Isaac always flagged them instead of ignoring them. Estimates list scope, costs, materials and timeline in detail.

items.title: Licensed and fully insured
items.text: USA Home Remodeling, Inc. holds California contractor licence CSLB #1080611 and carries full liability coverage and workers' compensation on every project.

about.text: Isaac Rozolyo earned a computer science degree and worked as a software engineer before moving into real estate investment and property renovation more than 18 years ago. Renovating his own properties, he saw how often contractors missed timelines or went quiet, and he started USA Home Remodeling to run projects with careful planning, clear pricing and hands-on oversight. Today he leads a team of designers, project managers and craftsmen, and he stays personally involved in every job so schedules hold and clients hear from him directly.

process.h2: Six steps from first meeting to warranty

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.text: Talk through your goals, style and budget, in your home or at the Irvine office, with no obligation.

steps.title: Design and 3D visualization
steps.text: The design team draws the plan and renders it in 3D so you can see the room before construction.

steps.title: Detailed estimate
steps.text: Once the design is final, you get a written scope with costs, materials and an expected timeline.

steps.title: Permits and preparation
steps.text: The team files permits and HOA submissions, books the schedule and orders materials so work starts smoothly.

steps.title: Build and walkthrough
steps.text: Crews keep a clean site with regular updates, then you review every detail together and receive the 3-year warranty.

service_area.h2: Irvine and the cities around it
service_area.text: The main office is in Irvine, with a second office in La Jolla for North San Diego County. In Irvine the team works from Woodbridge and Turtle Rock to Northwood, University Park and Great Park. Recent projects also span Newport Beach, Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Santa Ana, Orange, Placentia, Laguna Hills, Laguna Niguel and Mission Viejo, plus Carlsbad and Oceanside to the south.

faq.h2: What Irvine homeowners ask before remodeling

items.a: Yes. In-home estimates are free with no obligation to hire. The company has a $10,000 per-project minimum, and the home being estimated must be owned by you or at least in escrow. The 3D design is also included at no extra charge with every project.

items.q: What does a kitchen remodel cost in Orange County?
items.a: The company's own blog describes kitchen remodels in the $25,000 to $50,000 range and says most of its Orange County bathroom remodels land between $20,000 and $30,000. Your price depends on layout changes, cabinets, counters and appliances, and the detailed estimate spells it out line by line.

items.q: Will my HOA need to approve the remodel?
items.a: Often, yes. Many Irvine neighborhoods, such as Northwood, have HOA architectural review, and larger jobs need permits through Irvine Permit Services. USA Home Remodeling prepares the submissions, handles plan review and schedules inspections, so you do not have to manage the city process yourself.

You get a written 3-year labor and workmanship warranty at the final walkthrough. It covers the work the team performs. Product and appliance warranties come from their manufacturers, so keep those papers with your warranty letter.

items.q: Can I pick my own materials?
items.a: Yes. Cabinets, countertops and tile are chosen with you during the 3D design stage, and you can change them on screen until the room looks right. The company also passes its contractor pricing on finished materials directly to you.
